title: Mallarme
html_source:
Stéphane Mallarmé (1842 – 1898) was a French poet, and a key figure in the rise of literary Symbolism, which would dominate the early part of the twentieth century.

His self-reflexive poems, which explored the relationship of content and form, are famously obscure and difficult– by now, it’s clear to the reader the Anglo-Irish greats in the library don’t have a whole lot worth listening to, by comparison.
